components.name: Button
components.whenToUse: Use primary for the single main action on a screen. Use secondary for every other action.
components.whenNotToUse: Do not use two primary buttons on one screen.

components.name: TextInput
components.purpose: Collects one short line of text.
components.whenToUse: Use it for a single short answer, such as a name.
components.whenNotToUse: Do not use it for a long answer or a choice, and do not leave it unlabeled.

components.name: Type
components.whenToUse: Use display once for the page title, title for a section, body for reading text, and label for a caption.
components.whenNotToUse: Do not set a font size, family, or weight in the caller.

components.name: Badge
components.whenToUse: Use it to mark success, warning, error, or info next to the thing it describes.
components.whenNotToUse: Do not use it as a button or invent a tone.

components.name: Icon
components.purpose: Draws one icon from the active icon set.
components.whenToUse: Use it inside a control or next to a short label.
components.whenNotToUse: Do not import an icon library from a component.
